name: Length Lantern
description: A vector-MAGNITUDE machine for The Vector Bench. Grab the glowing cyan lantern at the tip of one amber arrow and pull it through the air — the machine instantly measures how far it reaches from the origin, |v| = sqrt(x^2+y^2+z^2), drawing its own right-triangle scaffolding in light. The three component legs (x along red, z on the floor, y rising) chain tip-to-tail, a faint right-angle box makes the Pythagoras construction explicit, and a floor diagonal sqrt(x^2+z^2) feeds the final rise so you watch sqrt nest inside sqrt. The lantern bead brightens to white-hot and a vertical cyan-violet ruler fills as |v| grows; near-zero length flips red. A SNAP-to-triple button (and slider release) plays a one-shot two-step resolve proof. Sibling of the catapult/force-bench teaching vectors.
theoreticalGrounding: A magnitude is not a number you are told — it is a diagonal you can see the construction of. 3D length is two Pythagoras theorems stacked: one on the floor (sqrt(x^2+z^2)), one rising to meet it, resolving to |v| = sqrt(x^2+y^2+z^2).

length_lantern.description: Dark slate pedestal + brass rim + etched integer ground lattice on a 0.6 m bench plate. One grabbable amber vector whose GrabSphere2 tip carries a glass lantern bead; pulling it redraws the faint x,y,z component legs, the explicit Pythagoras box, the floor diagonal sqrt(x^2+z^2), live numbers (components, squares, running sum, |v|), the lantern glow, and a vertical magnitude ruler. x/y/z precision sliders + a SNAP button trigger a 1.2 s eased two-stage resolve animation that makes sqrt-inside-sqrt temporally legible. DNA: reach, max_magnitude, degenerate_threshold, show_sliders, arrow_thickness.
length_lantern.qfep_connection: F_force: magnitude is the felt size of a vector — |v| is the diagonal the three components frame, length you can hold and watch brighten in your hand.
